title: A collision can reveal a factor
hook: A collision can reveal a factor. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Extract a composite factor from gcd of two polynomial-iteration values whose residues collide modulo a factor.

misconception: A repeated iterate is useful only when values repeat modulo the whole number.
objective: Extract a composite factor from gcd of two polynomial-iteration values whose residues collide modulo a factor.

claims.text: The two speeds can collide modulo a hidden factor before colliding modulo the whole number. Taking the gcd of their difference exposes that factor, while a trivial gcd requires another attempt.
